conditions: dry run: no live sources, no web, no writes
graded_by: a separate model run that did not write the answers

expectations.text: Names one primary phrase and up to three supporting phrases
expectations.evidence: 'Primary phrase: booking system design' and 'Supporting phrases: none. Candidate phrases must come in your words, and none were given.' Zero is within 'up to three'.

expectations.text: Gives each phrase a source or marks it unvalidated
expectations.evidence: 'booking system design (unvalidated; taken from your request, no volume, difficulty or ranking fetched)'

expectations.text: Returns an outline of topics, not headings or wording
expectations.evidence: 'Outline (topics in order, not headings)' with five topics, each 'rests on: to supply'

expectations.text: States the link rules and the schema and writes no copy
expectations.evidence: 'Schema: Service and BreadcrumbList. No author.'; 'two or three links across to sibling pages, descriptive anchors, no orphans or dead ends'; 'No heading, title, description or body copy is written here.'

expectations.text: Suggests title, first-line and tag terms, sourced or unvalidated
expectations.evidence: 'Primary term: care booking (unvalidated; taken from your request)', placed in 'Title', 'First line' and tag 1; tags 2 and 3 are 'to supply ... in your words'

expectations.text: Keeps tags few and specific
expectations.evidence: 'Tags: few and specific, three at most.' and 'No broad tags, no tag list at the end for reach'

expectations.text: Does not write the post and does not stuff hashtags
expectations.evidence: 'It does not write the post; `wugweb-work` writes it' and 'No hashtag stuffing.'

invented: The cap 'three at most' on tags is not in the skill, which says only 'few and specific'. It is the answer's own limit, not data; no volume, ranking or tag use is claimed.

expectations.text: Checks the rendered title at 60 or fewer, with no separate source limit
expectations.evidence: 'Rendered title: 60 characters or fewer, including " | Wugweb" where the site adds it'; measured '54 characters' and 'rendered title 69 characters, limit 60'. One limit only.

expectations.text: Checks the description is 140 to 160 characters
expectations.evidence: '148 characters | 140 to 160 | passes' and '26 characters, range 140 to 160'

expectations.text: Reports only what it finds and invents nothing
expectations.evidence: 'These are test files, not live wugweb.com pages.' The grader re-ran check-page.mjs on both example files and got the same figures (no findings and 17 checks passed; 69 and 26 characters; 4 blockers, 7 high, 4 medium, 1 low).

expectations.text: Requires WebPage, CreativeWork and BreadcrumbList on a case study
expectations.evidence: 'The rule for a case study on wugweb.com: `WebPage`, `CreativeWork` and `BreadcrumbList`'; reports 'missing WebPage, BreadcrumbList' on the failing example

expectations.text: Requires creator and publisher and no author
expectations.evidence: 'Wugweb is `creator` and `publisher`; no `author`'; fix 5 'On CreativeWork, remove author and set Wugweb as creator and publisher'

expectations.text: Flags HowTo, Review and AggregateRating as banned
expectations.evidence: 'no `HowTo`, `Review` or `AggregateRating`' and 'BLOCKER  JSON-LD  HowTo present  schema-banned-type'

expectations.text: Returns a per-test breakdown and a 0 to 100 total with a grade
expectations.evidence: 'Score: 14 of 100 (bad)' with 21 test lines and 'Bands: bad <=50, ok 51 to 80, great >80.' The grader re-ran score-page.mjs and got the same output.

expectations.text: Scores keyword density, keyword in a subheading and title readability
expectations.evidence: 'FAIL  0/6  keyword-density  (0.00%)', 'FAIL  0/3  keyword-in-subheading', and 'title-sentiment', 'title-power-word', 'title-number'

expectations.text: Writes no copy and hands fixes to wugweb-work or a developer
expectations.evidence: 'The score reports. It does not rewrite.' Fix list is 'to wugweb-work' and gives findings and checks, no wording.

expectations.text: Resolves each named bot against the path
expectations.evidence: Fifteen bots listed for /work/care-booking, each with its rule, for example 'BLOCKED  search  PerplexityBot  Disallow: /work/ (group PerplexityBot)'. Run on the shipped example file and labelled as such; the grader re-ran check-robots.mjs and got the same output.

expectations.text: Requires search and citation bots to be allowed
expectations.evidence: 'BLOCKER  robots.txt  PerplexityBot disallowed on /work/' and 'A search and citation bot must reach every page that should be found.'

expectations.text: Treats training bots as the owner's choice, asked once
expectations.evidence: 'Training bots are the owner's choice. Report them; do not change them.' and 'On wugweb.com you allow training bots (2026-11-17)'. That decision is recorded in references/audit.md, so it is not asked again.

expectations.text: Confirms the drop is real before diagnosing
expectations.evidence: 'I can't diagnose it yet' and asks for sessions 'to confirm the drop is real and not a measurement fault'. No diagnosis is given before that.

expectations.text: Follows the fixed check order for a drop
expectations.evidence: 'in this order, stopping at the first cause found: 1. Tracking ... 2. Indexing: did robots.txt, a noindex, a canonical or a deploy change? 3. Search engine update ... 4. Results features ... 5. Competitors ... 6. Content decay'

expectations.text: Names source and dates or marks numbers unvalidated
expectations.evidence: 'No number in this reply, because none was supplied.' Source and periods are named: 'Search Console export ... October 2026 ... September 2026 ... October 2025'.

expectations.text: Uses a fixed monthly prompt sample
expectations.evidence: 'A fixed list of prompts a buyer would ask, in your words. It stays the same every month.' The answer says none exists yet and asks for it.

expectations.text: Runs each prompt several times and reports how often Wugweb appears
expectations.evidence: No AI tool, web access or logged runs in a dry run, so nothing could be run or counted: '0 prompts run; cited not measured, mentioned not measured, absent not measured'. The answer states the method ('Each prompt run several times per tool, in fresh sessions') and refuses to report zero.

expectations.text: Reads the trend across months, not a single run
expectations.evidence: No month of data exists to read: 'trend: none, no earlier month on record'. The answer states the rule only: 'This month would be the first point, so it cannot show a trend; that needs several months.'
